title: Speed limit of a massive body
references: Einstein, A., Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Koerper, Annalen der Physik 322(10), 891-921 (1905), doi:10.1002/andp.19053221004
Rindler, W., Relativity: Special, General, and Cosmological, 2nd ed., Oxford University Press (2006)
validity_domain: Speed of a body with non-zero rest mass, measured in an inertial frame, through space.
limitations: Does not apply to light or other massless particles, nor to phase or group velocities in a medium
Does not apply to the recession velocity of distant galaxies or to coordinate speeds in curved spacetime
A bound of special relativity: a body of non-zero mass stays strictly below c, and no technology is implied to approach it
